## SearXNG MCP Server

SearXNG MCP Server connects AI assistants to an operator-controlled or trusted SearXNG instance for privacy-respecting web search. It supports searching, query suggestions, instance discovery, and reading selected public URLs as text or Markdown. Configure the SearXNG endpoint to a service you operate or trust, because that service receives search queries. URL reading intentionally reaches user-supplied public URLs, so the server requires broad outbound-network access.
